Oracle miss with named Google/OpenAI deals, YouGov warning, Adobe beat and Broadcom beat each have local support. Micron preview and Nike analyst view remain pending/opinion. No result from preview or invented estimates.
Grid-reliability constraint is supported by Utility Dive, while suggested instruments are conditional expressions. No measured low-ownership claim, new orders or approved cost recovery invented.

Micron event explicitly supported by preview; MU close and five/twenty-session returns exact. Results and implied earnings number not invented; position remains measured before event.

EV talks remain planned, no agreement or earnings improvement assumed. European-auto medium-horizon weakness is supported by own EXV5.DE mark already verified; commercial access and orders are triggers.
Ueda July possibility remains possibility and demand-inflation counter-signal is supported. No precise currency forecast, intervention date or completed policy decision.

Micron valuation article supports opinion and local preview added for event status. MU close/latest/twenty-session changes exact; no actual earnings result inferred.
Dell and Super Micro are suppliers to xAI under Reuters title. DELL close/five/twenty-session values exact; no invented project revenue or margins; cash-conversion risks replace source-input aside.
Broadcom actual beat/split title checked; as-traded USD level and comparable twenty-session return exact. Reconstruction/later-unit instruction removed; no synthetic split conversion or target.
Nike skeptical analyst assessment remains opinion. NKE close/five/twenty-session numbers exact; future results and management guidance not invented.
